name: Lemon verbena

schedule.notes: Buy a plant; cuttings root in summer. Pot for overwintering indoors in zones 7 and below.
Snip stem tips. Pinch tips early to encourage bushy growth.

harvest.cues: Stems 6 in, leaves narrow and lance-shaped, intense lemon scent when rubbed.
harvest.storageNotes: Dries excellently — flavor and scent hold for 1 to 2 years in sealed jars. Use 2 to 3 dried leaves per cup of tea.

varieties.name: Common Lemon Verbena
varieties.notes: The classic. Single cultivar in commerce.

notes: Most intensely lemony of any herb. Stunning in tea (alone or blended with mint), syrups, sorbets, and shortbread. Deciduous — drops leaves in winter and looks dead until late spring. Don't give up on it.
